**Japan's Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (data period 2026-05-01), which ranks it 32nd of 121 countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population, and 1.0 is the global average. At 1.91, Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population size alone would predict.

Some context:
- **Work, personal and coursework use:** 47% work, 47% personal and 6% coursework. The global figures are 43%, 40% and 16%.
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** 53% of use is augmentation (working with Claude) and 47% is automation (handing tasks off). Globally the split is 51% and 49%.
- **Top job categories:** Computer and Mathematical is the largest at 23%. Arts, Design, Entertainment, Sports, and Media is next at 15%.

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
